description: Split text into independently checkable atomic factual claims: the low-cost first step of a verification loop (extract, ground, attest). Returns claims, count and input_sha256, plus a signed receipt bound to the input hash. Useful to see which claims a document makes before paying to ground them, to budget a verification pass by grounding only the claims that matter, or to prove later exactly which claims came from which text. Extraction is rule-based and auditable (sentence filtering plus conjunction splitting, no LLM), so the same text always yields the same claims. Limits: it keeps declarative factual sentences and skips questions, opinions, instructions and first-person statements; it splits only on high-precision conjunction boundaries, so a compound it cannot safely split stays whole. It verifies nothing: verdicts come from this server's grounding tools. Paid per call (x402), at the lowest price on this server.
